channel.title: Glass Power Tools
channel.description: Glass Power Tools for Mac updates

item.title: Glass Power Tools 0.4.548
item.description:
0.4.548

  • Terminal color schemes. Import macOS Terminal profiles (.terminal files, or a folder of them) and choose among them in a terminal's Settings ▸ All Terminals ▸ Theme ▸ Choose…, each shown in its own colors. They're kept in iCloud Drive ▸ Glass Power Tools ▸ Terminal Themes for every device, and This Window can use one too. Background, text, selection, cursor and all sixteen colors come across; your font stays. Open With Glass Power Tools on a .terminal file adds it.
  • Git in the editor. A project's branch at the foot of its files, a Changes tab, change marks beside the lines, staging and committing, and now Pull, Push, Fetch and Publish Branch, with plain words when one can't go ahead.
  • Four more terminal looks: Coding Agent, Aurora, Starfield and Blueprint. A Workgroup can have a look of its own.
  • Mermaid diagrams a program prints in a terminal, as Claude Code does, are marked and open as pictures. Tabs show the coding agent they're running.
  • New terminals from the sidebar: right-click its empty space for what the toolbar's + offers.
  • ⌘F finds in the editor, with Find Next and Find Previous.
  • A database that won't connect says why, and its Connection Details show where the tunnel goes. A remote desktop that ends the session says why.
  • A Files window opened on an empty folder fills the window, instead of a message floating in clear glass.
  • Saved connections changed on another device stay changed. Cancel and the time limit stop any SQLite query. A tmux server the app started can be stopped.

Everything in this build: the release notes.

item.title: Glass Power Tools 0.4.494
item.description:
0.4.494

  • Scale Text works on this Mac's own terminals, tmux tabs included.
  • Open Folder in Editor, in a terminal's gear menu: the project that holds the shell's folder, or a new editor window.
  • A local terminal's gear menu no longer repeats the toolbar's buttons.
  • A Mac signed out of iCloud says so, and how to sign in, instead of "iCloud sync failed".

item.title: Glass Power Tools 0.4.491
item.description:
The first Mac release

  • Your Library counts the time you spend on each machine.
  • A Mac recognises its own record in the library.
  • Looks for terminal windows: Digital Rain, Synthwave, phosphor, pictures, glow.
  • Right-click SQL in a terminal to open it in the query editor.
  • tmux tabs keep every line.
